title: UseHighContrastScheme
description: Returns the high contrast scheme name (e.g., "High Contrast Black", "High Contrast White") or null if not in high contrast mode. Automatically re-renders the component when the scheme changes.

---
title: "UseHighContrastScheme"
description: "Returns the high contrast scheme name (e.g., \"High Contrast Black\", \"High Contrast White\") or null if not in high contrast mode. Automatically re-renders the component when the scheme changes."
---

> **Learn more:** [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks), [Effects](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/effects)



Must be called instead of (not in addition to) [UseHighContrast](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/hooks/UseHighContrast) ([guide](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks))
because each consumes the same hook slots. Use one or the other.
